diagnostics.summary: Rule with path '/Probe3/Rows/RowValComp': The maximum number of fractional digits of the left-hand side (0) and of the right-hand side (2) are different. [MVK_INVALID_COMPARE_DEC_PLACES]
diagnostics.fix: The kernel could not establish compatible DERIVED decimal scales here. Numeric == / != carries a known SIGNED scale or unknown plus an independent multiplicative-constant capability: when known scales differ, only a capable SMALLER-scale side may be padded; an unknown scale rejects.
